articles.title: Protests in National Capital Risk ₹4,000 Crore in Business Losses, Warns Traders
articles.summary: Protests in Delhi are disrupting business activity, with traders estimating that daily transactions worth around ₹400 crore are at risk. If the disruptions continue for 10 days, cumulative losses could reach ₹4,000 crore, according to traders’ concerns. The timing has heightened worries as businesses prepare for the festive season, when markets typically see increased customer footfall and sales.

articles.title: Why India’s steelmakers are eyeing coal gasification despite high costs
articles.summary: This is a Mint Premium article gifted to you. Subscribe to enjoy similar stories. articles.title: Prime Minister Modi Faces Growing Scrutiny Over Indian Democracy And Governance
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi faces intense pressure regarding minority rights, institutional independence, and economic growth in India. articles.title_hinglish: emaemasi, eesasiaaee ne vaijnyanika thosa apashishta prabandhana ko majabuta karane ke lie samajhauta jnyapana para hastakshara kie
articles.summary_hinglish: sajhedari ka uddeshya prashikshan, aadhunika apashishta-prabandhana prathaon aura sansthagata kshamata nirmana ke madhyama se satata shahari vikasa ka samarthana karana hai। haidarabad: malkajagiri nagara nigama (emaemasi) aura edaministretiva stapha koleja ऑpha indiya (eesasiaaee) ne shahari kshetron men vaijnyanika thosa apashishta prabandhana men sudhar, nagarapalika adhikariyon ke kaushala ko badhaाne aura paryavarana-anukula shaharon ke vikasa ke lie sansthagata kshamata ko majabuta karane ke lie eka samajhauta jnyapana (emaoyu) para hastakshara kie।

articles.summary_hi: पंजाब प्रदूषण नियंत्रण बोर्ड (पीपीसीबी) ने मिशन क्लीन पटियाला के साथ हवा की गुणवत्ता में सुधार के लिए अपनी अभिनव पहल के लिए राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर पहचान हासिल की है, जिसमें केंद्रीय प्रदूषण नियंत्रण बोर्ड (सीपीसीबी) के राष्ट्रीय स्वच्छ वायु कार्यक्रम (एनसीएपी), 2026 के तहत सर्वोत्तम प्रथाओं के संग्रह में शामिल, पटियाला के एक श्मशान में वायु प्रदूषण नियंत्रण उपकरण (एपीसीडी) की स्थापना शामिल है।
articles.title_hinglish: panjaba ki svachchha vayu pahala sarvottama prathaon ki rashtriya suchi men shamila hai
articles.summary_hinglish: panjaba pradushana niyantrana borda (pipisibi) ne mishana klina patiyala ke satha hava ki gunavatta men sudhara ke lie apani abhinava pahala ke lie rashtriya stara para pahachana hasila ki hai, jisamen kendriya pradushana niyantrana borda (sipisibi) ke rashtriya svachchha vayu karyakrama (enasiepi), 2026 ke tahata sarvottama prathaon ke sangraha men shamil, patiyala ke eka shmashana men vayu pradushana niyantrana upakarana (episidi) ki sthapana shamila hai।

articles.title: HC told businessman facing extortion threats already provided security

articles.title: Indian ruling party accuses opposition of inciting street protests

This debate highlights ongoing tensions between ballot box mandates and citizen agitation as a tool for political change.

articles.title: Two youths drown in Kinnerasani canal in Kothagudem district
articles.summary: Kothagudem: Two youths reportedly drowned in the Kinnerasani canal at Karakavagu area of Paloncha in the district on Saturday. articles.title: Congress Defends Regime Change Demands Amid Voter Roll Protests

articles.title: ICAR-IIOR's Smart Seed Coating tech strengthens climate-resilient oil seed farming

articles.summary: Leader of the opposition Jai Ram Thakur stated that a future Bharatiya Janata Party government will review new administrative blocks created by the Congress government in Himachal Pradesh if they were formed for political gains. articles.title: Allahabad High Court Orders Uttar Pradesh Panchayat Elections Within Three Months
articles.summary: The Allahabad High Court ordered the Uttar Pradesh government to complete panchayat elections within three months. Delivered on October 14, 2026, the judgment directs that the polls proceed under the existing Other Backward Classes reservation framework while a dedicated commission continues its inquiry. This ruling resolves legal petitions concerning delayed rural local body elections and administrative arrangements.

articles.summary_hi: भारत में आपातकाल के पचास वर्ष पूरे हो गए हैं, जो इस बात को प्रतिबिंबित करता है कि इसे देश की लोकतांत्रिक यात्रा का सबसे काला दौर माना जाता है। ऐतिहासिक मील का पत्थर सरकारी मंचों पर उस युग की घटनाओं पर राष्ट्रीय नजर डालने का संकेत देता है। पर्यवेक्षक देश भर में आधुनिक शासन और नागरिक स्वतंत्रता पर इस महत्वपूर्ण अध्याय के स्थायी प्रभाव का विश्लेषण करते हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: aapatakala ke pachasa sala bada bharata ke sabase kale lokatantrika kshana para vichara karate hue
articles.summary_hinglish: bharata men aapatakala ke pachasa varsha pure ho gae hain, jo isa bata ko pratibinbita karata hai ki ise desha ki lokatantrika yatra ka sabase kala daura mana jata hai। aitihasika mila ka patthara sarakari manchon para usa yuga ki ghatanaon para rashtriya najara dalane ka sanketa deta hai। paryavekshaka desha bhara men aadhunika shasana aura nagarika svatantrata para isa mahatvapurna adhyaya ke sthayi prabhava ka vishleshana karate hain।

articles.title: Six surrendered militants arrested for blocking national highway in Tripura
articles.summary: Around 16 surrendered militants, led by Kaklaijoy Tripura, gathered at Hataikator and blocked the highway in the morning, police spokesperson Rajdeep Deb said. An Executive Magistrate, Arajit Debbarma, was deputed to the spot and asked the protesters to lift the blockade, citing the ongoing festival season. However, they refused to comply, Deb said.
articles.title_hi: त्रिपुरा में राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अवरुद्ध करने के आरोप में आत्मसमर्पण करने वाले छह उग्रवादियों को गिरफ्तार किया गया
articles.summary_hi: पुलिस प्रवक्ता राजदीप देब ने कहा कि काकलाईजॉय त्रिपुरा के नेतृत्व में आत्मसमर्पण करने वाले लगभग 16 उग्रवादी सुबह हतैकेटर में एकत्र हुए और राजमार्ग को अवरुद्ध कर दिया। एक कार्यकारी मजिस्ट्रेट, अराजित देबबर्मा को मौके पर तैनात किया गया और उन्होंने त्योहार के मौसम का हवाला देते हुए प्रदर्शनकारियों से नाकाबंदी हटाने के लिए कहा। हालाँकि, उन्होंने अनुपालन करने से इनकार कर दिया, देब ने कहा।
articles.title_hinglish: tripura men rashtriya rajamarga avaruddha karane ke aaropa men aatmasamarpana karane vale chhaha ugravadiyon ko giraphtara kiya gaya
articles.summary_hinglish: pulisa pravakta rajadipa deba ne kaha ki kakalaeejoya tripura ke netritva men aatmasamarpana karane vale lagabhaga 16 ugravadi subaha hataiketara men ekatra hue aura rajamarga ko avaruddha kara diya। eka karyakari majistret, arajita debabarma ko mauke para tainata kiya gaya aura unhonne tyohara ke mausama ka havala dete hue pradarshanakariyon se nakabandi hatane ke lie kaha। halanki, unhonne anupalana karane se inakara kara diy, deba ne kaha।

articles.title: Tamil Nadu BJP alleges temple entry violated Madras High Court order
articles.summary: The party alleged that the entry violated temple rules and a Madras High Court order issued in January 2024, which prohibits non-Hindus from proceeding beyond the temple's flagstaff without recording an undertaking of faith in the deity and agreeing to follow Hindu customs. BJP chief spokesperson Narayanan Thirupathy called the incident a "clear violation" of the court order.
articles.title_hi: तमिलनाडु बीजेपी का आरोप है कि मंदिर में प्रवेश ने मद्रास हाई कोर्ट के आदेश का उल्लंघन किया है
articles.summary_hi: पार्टी ने आरोप लगाया कि प्रवेश ने मंदिर के नियमों और जनवरी 2024 में जारी मद्रास उच्च न्यायालय के आदेश का उल्लंघन किया, जो गैर-हिंदुओं को देवता में विश्वास का वचन दर्ज किए बिना और हिंदू रीति-रिवाजों का पालन करने के लिए सहमत हुए बिना मंदिर के ध्वजदंड से आगे बढ़ने से रोकता है। भाजपा के मुख्य प्रवक्ता नारायणन तिरुपति ने इस घटना को अदालत के आदेश का "स्पष्ट उल्लंघन" बताया।
articles.title_hinglish: tamilanadu bijepi ka aaropa hai ki mandira men pravesha ne madrasa haee korta ke aadesha ka ullanghana kiya hai
articles.summary_hinglish: parti ne aaropa lagaya ki pravesha ne mandira ke niyamon aura janavari 2024 men jari madrasa uchcha nyayalaya ke aadesha ka ullanghana kiy, jo gaira-hinduon ko devata men vishvasa ka vachana darja kie bina aura hindu riti-rivajon ka palana karane ke lie sahamata hue bina mandira ke dhvajadanda se aage badhane se rokata hai। bhajapa ke mukhya pravakta narayanana tirupati ne isa ghatana ko adalata ke aadesha ka "spashta ullanghana" bataya।

articles.summary_hinglish: kisi anya eemela se sadasyata li gaee? logaaauta karen aura usake satha logina karen। primiyama kahaniyon, sanpadakiy, raya aura bahuta kuchha ke satha khata sadasyata labha। sadasyata ke satha inhen analoka karen vishva mamalon ko bharatiya drishtikona se dekhate hue bharata ka drishtikona। sinema aura striminga ki duniya se pahala din, pahala sho samachara aura samikshaen।

articles.title: Simran Sharma replaces Bhavina as India's flag bearer at Para Asian Games
articles.summary: "The decision has been taken to ensure that Bhavina, a wheelchair athlete, has sufficient time to rest and prepare for her crucial quarter-final. The journey to and from the venue takes nearly six hours, which would be physically demanding and leave her with limited time to recover ahead of the match," the PCI said.

articles.title: Nielsen Positions India as Its Primary Global Innovation Engine, With 75% of Innovation
articles.summary: Chief Technology Officer Anil Goel said the company’s India operations were designed to function as a global innovation centre rather than a conventional global capability centre (GCC). “Unlike traditional GCCs where India-based teams work under overseas counterparts, Nielsen’s local teams lead products, make decisions and work directly with global clients,” the report said, citing Goel.

articles.title: Indian student groups protest against CEC, SIR in London; Govt supporters hold
articles.summary: Protests took place in London at Mahatma Gandhi's statue, where crowds gathered to voice their opinions. Opposing groups supported and protested against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Keynote speaker Dhruv Rathee urged for changes in the election commission while opposing foreign interference.

articles.title: Trump waives tariffs on top Russian oil and gas buyers
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump has waived tariffs of up to 100 per cent on goods imported from the five largest buyers of Russian oil or gas, along with specified sanctions under a new law targeting Moscow, news agency Press Trust of India reported. Trump cited the national interest of the United States for the decision.
articles.title_hi: ट्रम्प ने शीर्ष रूसी तेल और गैस खरीदारों पर शुल्क माफ कर दिया
articles.summary_hi: समाचार एजेंसी प्रेस ट्रस्ट ऑफ इंडिया की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प ने मॉस्को को लक्षित एक नए कानून के तहत निर्दिष्ट प्रतिबंधों के साथ-साथ रूसी तेल या गैस के पांच सबसे बड़े खरीदारों से आयातित वस्तुओं पर 100 प्रतिशत तक टैरिफ माफ कर दिया है। ट्रम्प ने इस फैसले के लिए संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका के राष्ट्रीय हित का हवाला दिया।

articles.title_hi: जेलर 2 बॉक्स ऑफिस कलेक्शन दिन 3: रजनीकांत के बराबर 150 करोड़ रुपये की उम्मीद

articles.title_hinglish: jelara 2 boksa ऑphisa kalekshana dina 3: rajanikanta ke barabara 150 karoda rupaye ki ummida
